Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.motion

Interface FindDynamicPixels

All Known Implementing Classes:
ChangedPixels, DynamicPixelFinder, MotionDetector
public interface FindDynamicPixels
Interface for identifying dynamic (changing) and fixed (unchanging) pixels across a sequence of images. Implementations analyze temporal changes to create binary masks distinguishing moving from stationary content.

This interface is fundamental to motion detection in Brobot, enabling:

  • Motion-based object tracking
  • Activity detection in screen regions
  • Separation of foreground from background elements
  • Identification of animated UI components

Implementations may use various techniques such as:

  • Frame differencing
  • Pixel-wise comparison
  • Statistical analysis of pixel values
  • Threshold-based change detection

  • Method Details

    • getDynamicPixelMask

      org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getDynamicPixelMask(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.MatVector matVector)
      Creates a binary mask identifying pixels that change across the image sequence. Dynamic pixels typically represent moving objects, animations, or changing content.
      Parameters:
      matVector - collection of images to analyze for temporal changes
      Returns:
      binary Mat where dynamic pixels are marked (typically as 255/white)

    • getFixedPixelMask

      org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getFixedPixelMask(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.MatVector matVector)
      Creates a binary mask identifying pixels that remain constant across the image sequence. Fixed pixels typically represent static backgrounds or unchanging UI elements.
      Parameters:
      matVector - collection of images to analyze for temporal changes
      Returns:
      binary Mat where fixed pixels are marked (typically as 255/white)
